_help: Phone alerts (engine/notify.py, docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md). To change anything, tell Claude (STATE.md 'Waiting on the owner'): Claude changes this file in the repo; never edit it on the PC (a local edit stops the PC's auto-update). true = on, false = off. Times are New York (ET). In quiet hours ordinary alerts arrive WITHOUT sound (summaries and milestones wait for the end); the kinds in ring_in_quiet_hours still ring. Owner 2026-11-18 "important only" + every entry the moment it happens (trade_opened, owner 2026-11-18 evening: "notifications when we get in a trade in any account"): trade results, pass / fail / locked / payout ready (account_status), PC silent, the daily summary, the 07:30 ET morning brief (morning_brief, morning_brief_at). Problems (bot down / FEED STALE / NinjaTrader closed) stay ON as emergencies (lead 2026-11-18). Since 2026-11-20 (owner: "notifications for trade entries I never got one from today. And results") these go to the Olympus app AND the ntfy app: a trade's entry and result; PASSED / FAILED / LOCKED / payout ready / no trade for 5+ days (account_status; each account: the 50K, ATLAS, the 25K #2, the Rapid EOD; the count knows only the bot's own trades); the problems the 15-minute report sends (bot down, NinjaTrader closed, FEED STALE; the ones the PC's fast alarm already sent in entry hours stay on ntfy only, 'Back to normal' stays Olympus first); room low (daily loss limit 70% used, drawdown 50% / 75% used: ON since 2026-11-22, owner "every important event"). PC silent comes from the cloud, on ntfy. trade_routes: both (default); olympus = Olympus first, ntfy only when no phone took it; ntfy = ntfy first, Olympus only when ntfy did not take it. At night trade alerts still show, without sound; ringing at night is the owner's yes / no (STATE.md 'Waiting on the owner'): Claude changes this file, never a hand edit on the PC (a local edit stops the PC's auto-update). Check the routes: python -X utf8 -m engine.alert_check --test. setup_progress (ON since 2026-11-25, owner: "any time we get closer"): LIT at the Brain's step 5 / 7 / 8 + 'setup cancelled', ATLAS 30 / 10 pts from a level + armed; at most 12 a day; 23:00-07:00 ET only 'entering now'.
